body:
Before you get through all those files. I highly recommend doing some profiling and identifying places where the change will make a tangible difference! Reducing memory allocations can be very beneficial, but many of these calling locations are functions that are rarely called and/or have small array lengths and thus won't really benefit. 

We should restrict changes to places that have a measurable benefit otherwise this PR will get stuck in review hell (from being too long) and the cost of creating a bunch of git noise will outweigh the marginal benefit of the changes.
